reaction: The distinction between making methane and producing tank-ready fuel was a satisfying, useful detail.

mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting the reactor was most worthwhile: the explanation of metered feeds and reaction cooling made the equipment's purpose physically clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the catalyst was relatively slight as a standalone action, although keeping the gas path clean made sense.

surprise.text: The first methane came mixed with water vapour and unreacted gases, rather than being immediately usable fuel.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though each decision had only one offered combination, leaving little room for meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the methane is processed and the samples brought home; the unfinished fuel and discovery make the return interesting.
